reviewed_finding: On one fixed graph with four vertices and five oriented edges (cycle rank2), enumerate all Z/N edge labels, remove the declared spanning-tree gauge and retain both chord invariants. Arbitrary vertex repairs preserve them; all N² invariant pairs occur for retained N<=4. The source ConnectednessShadow only means not exponent two: finite C3/C4 pass it.
